defect: The default python3 selected by PATH cannot import pandas even though the task says the pandas-based script is ready to debug.
evidence: environment/Dockerfile installs pandas for the system interpreter but puts /usr/local/bin before /usr/bin; every trace attempt-01.jsonl through attempt-12.jsonl records ModuleNotFoundError on its first plain-python3 run (turns 3-5).
change: Put /usr/bin before /usr/local/bin in PATH so plain python3 uses the interpreter with pandas installed.

defect: The public instruction names avg_order_value but does not define whether it averages unit price or transaction revenue, while grading accepts only average transaction revenue.
evidence: instruction.md leaves the metric undefined, tests/test_outputs.py expects total_revenue divided by transaction_count, and all 12 attempts compute mean unit price; replayed attempt-01.jsonl fails only the value checks for that mismatch.
change: Define an order's value as that transaction's price times quantity and require avg_order_value to average those order values.
